chapter: Instruments, tenors and the current band
title: Current trumpet section: Glenn Drewes, Jim Powers, Dave Kennedy
summary: He names the current trumpeters Glenn Drewes, Jim Powers, lead player Dave Kennedy, and an alternate; Jay Sollenberger has left.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: There's a trumpeter, his name was -- I'm going bad with names. His name is --
(Recording interrupted.)
No, the guy is one of the better jazz trumpet players
in the band, I think, in recent years.
Is that right?
Yeah, he's excellent, and I think you've heard him once or maybe twice. And his name is Drewes Troos --
Oh, Glenn Drewes, yeah.
I'm very proud of him. I think every time I listen to him, he gets better.
Uh-huh.
Which is one of the rare --
Because when he first joined the band early on, he had a few opportunities to play.
That's right, but now he's taken over more and more.
Oh, marvellous.
And he has a guy standing next to him by the name of Jim -- let's see if I get this one right -- Jim -- oh, he's from the Midwest or someplace. Powers, Jim Powers.
Powers?
Yeah. And excellent inventive jazz player. Very young and very gracious, and then, --
Is Jay still with you?
The bass player?
No, Sollenberger.
Oh, no, Jay's been away now for almost -- well, I guess since the last time we were on the --
Oh, I see, because I didn't see him.
And we have a newer lead player who came in as his alternate lead player who's been playing lead ever since. And his name is Dave Kennedy.
Oh, really?
Yeah. And he does a very good job.
Uh-huh.
And I don't think we'll have him too much longer. And then we'll hope for another one, right?
Uh-huh.
And then other people -- Ken -- very good Irish name, Ken Somebody and he's been there a few months.
The other trumpet player?
Yeah.
I see.
He does very well. He's the alternate.
